budget_items.what_was_said: As a benchmark, the presenter cited what the town recently paid a union contractor to replace two boilers at St. Bernard's Elementary School, covering that work and other items.

decisions.decision: Committee agreed to ask the feasibility study to scope three options for the TC Pasios site: senior housing alone, senior housing plus a community center, and senior housing plus community center plus a town green.
Presenter (Stephen Wallace) agreed to contact several firms to get ballpark estimates for the feasibility study cost before the next meeting.
Committee agreed to work up a shared spreadsheet/document combining square footage assumptions (employees, storage, meeting rooms) to bring to the Select Board and Town Manager.

minutes.headline: Committee voted the current town hall (Ritter) building is too small and needs an addition.
minutes.summary: A guest presenter briefed the committee on how the town could pursue affordable senior housing, including using the TC Pasios site for senior housing, a community center, and a town green, with a feasibility study to be scoped and estimated. The committee then voted that the Ritter Building's current square footage cannot accommodate all town hall functions and discussed addition/annex design options, cost comparisons, and next steps for a document to bring to the Select Board; TC Pasios's failing boilers and the fate of its teen center and food pantry tenants were also discussed without a vote.

what_happened.line: The committee voted that the Ritter Building's current square footage cannot fit all town hall functions.
A guest presenter outlined using the TC Pasios site for senior housing, a community center, and a town green.
Committee agreed to have a feasibility study scope three versions of the TC Pasios plan before the next meeting.
Committee agreed to draft a joint square-footage and cost document, comparing renovation to a new addition, for the Select Board.
Failing boilers at TC Pasios were discussed as threatening its teen center and food pantry tenants once it gets cold, with no vote taken.

why_it_matters: The vote that the Ritter Building is too small moves the committee toward proposing an addition, a project that would eventually need Select Board and town meeting approval.
The TC Pasios feasibility study could determine whether that site becomes senior housing, a community center, a town green, or some combination -- a choice residents may later vote to fund.
Unrepaired boilers at TC Pasios put the building's teen center and food pantry programs at risk of losing usable space this winter.
